reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and the cited paragraphs support it: the licence grant in p0030 and p0043 is expressly non-exclusive and contains only scope-of-licence/IP-protection covenants, with no requirements, minimum-volume or sole-supplier commitment binding Licensee (our party).

The Article XXII Right of First Refusal (p0139) is correctly characterised as a first-refusal right over an asset sale or change of control, i.e. an exit/M&A restraint, not a lock-in requiring us to source platform services from Licensor; it therefore belongs to the change-of-control/assignment rule rather than EXCLUSIVITY, avoiding double-flagging.
The 'exclusive purpose' language in the Field of Use definition is a use-scope limitation, not an obligation to buy exclusively from Licensor, so it does not trigger the rule.

Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline was rendered (redline text is identical to the original) and no counterparty comment was raised; the deterministic check confirming no residual sole-supplier obligation is satisfied.
